HEADER: Init +7; Senses Dragon senses, see in darkness; Perception +13
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Black Waves, Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 shadow damage, Reflex DC 16 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)
At will - bleed, dark orb, detect magic, message, read magic
2nd (DC 19) - dark II, death armor, death knell
3rd (DC 20) - blacklight, dark III, darkra, dispel, haste, infect (DC 19)
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 22
Base Atk +9; CMB +13; CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Elemental Focus (Shadow), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack

SPECIAL ABILITIES: Black Waves (su) As a standard action, a black dragon spreads dark waves from herself. All creatures within a 30 ft.-radius must make a Reflex save (DC 20) for half damage or take 3d6+12 points of shadow damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

Fearful Bay (su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a black dragon howls, all creatures within a 30-foot spread except evil outsiders must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or become panicked for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by the same black dragon's fearful bay for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
See in Darkness (su) A black dragon can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by the blacklight spell.

curation.summary: Young Black Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 33 generated item(s) across 7 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
